hooks.text: Reviewers called the solar wind nonsense before it was proven.
A million-degree solar wind tears through our solar system constantly.
Four lines of algebra proved the Sun is bleeding plasma.

title: The Solar Wind Discovery Called Utter Nonsense
description: How astrophysicist Eugene Parker's groundbreaking solar wind theory survived peer review rejection to reshape our understanding of space plasma.
